name: Horse locomotion law (no sliding, real turns) with a movement checker
what: One movement law for every horse: bounded acceleration and braking, turns limited by speed (no pivoting at rest, wide arcs at a gallop), motion only along the facing, stride phase advanced by distance so hooves never slide, the body laid along the trail it rode so planted hooves stay put in turns, and a lean into turns. Comes with a checker that judges every horse every step (off-facing, backward, jumps, accel, turn, overlap, hoof slide) and a sabotage mode that proves the checker works.
use_when: the game has horses, riders, deer, camels or any four-legged or wheeled body that must move believably (no strafing, no moonwalking, no spinning on the spot), especially many of them, and you want a test that proves it
good_for: a ridden horse with A/D and W/S that feels like a horse; herds and cavalry that move honestly; any animal whose clips have a stride length; proving in a test that nothing slides or teleports
not_for: flying, swimming or jumping creatures; physics-driven bodies (ragdolls, vehicles on suspension); keeping horses apart (the law does not avoid others: your steering must); hand-animated clips with no stride length
how_to_add: node tools/blocks/add.mjs meticulai-horse-locomotion, then import createHerd from vendor/meticulai-horse-locomotion/src/herd.js; call herd.step(i, wantYaw, wantSpeed, dt) each fixed step and draw each horse at (S.mx, S.mz, S.myaw); see HOW-TO-USE.md
